title: Collector Set DLC: Gear up for Frozen Trail
body:
# Collector Set DLC: Gear up for Frozen Trail

Raiders,

Frozen Trail has arrived. Log in now to dive into all the new content: a new map, a massive ARC Operation, new enemies, weapon upgrades, new items, Outposts, and much more.

# Collector Set DLC

Raiders looking to fully kit themselves out for the new frontier can pick up the Collector Set DLC. It grants access to a new cosmetic set, the Renzo, the Dragon's Breath Weapon Stencil, the Bob Hair Style, and 2,400 Raider Tokens. The bundle also includes an exclusive Retro Sofa for your Raider Outpost, and it is the only way to obtain a blueprint for the new Banjo musical instrument.

Buying the Collector Set DLC also unlocks the Frozen Trail Premium Reward Pass. This pass gives you every premium toggle, modification, and colorway for the new outfits. It also includes exclusive legendary weapon stencils, hairstyles, and up to 1,150 Raider Tokens in total.

Take a look at the Collector Set DLC to see all the cosmetics and rewards on offer for yourself. It is available now on Xbox, PlayStation, Epic, and Steam.

Gear up and get out there, Raider.
